description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) on the x-axis and BLEU score on the y-axis for three different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, and Inconsistency-CE-MP, as evaluated in the context of simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” ranges from 0 to approximately 7, with tick marks at integer intervals (0, 2, 4, 6). The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” spans from 12 to 28, with major gridlines and tick labels every 2 units (12, 14, ..., 28). The “Consistency-CE” model is represented by a purple dashed line with circle markers, starting at BLEU ≈13 at AL=0 and rising steadily to BLEU ≈26.5 at AL≈7. The “Inconsistency-CE” model is shown as a dark purple dashed line with square markers, beginning at BLEU≈20 at AL=0 and increasing to BLEU≈27 at AL≈7. The “Inconsistency-CE-MP” model is depicted by a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at BLEU≈20 at AL=0 and rising to BLEU≈27 at AL≈7, closely tracking the Inconsistency-CE line. The red solid line with star markers, labeled in the legend as “Inconsistency-CE-MP” but visually distinct and likely mislabeled, starts at BLEU≈22.5 at AL=0 and increases to BLEU≈28 at AL≈7, consistently outperforming the other lines across the range. All lines show a positive trend, indicating that higher average lagging correlates with higher BLEU scores for all models.
